physDesc.physMedium: 1 folded folio. Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. Heading: "Liden Kirsten af Heiberg". At the end of the music dated: "April 1841". Vocal part without text and sporadic indication of accompaniment.

annot.p: In the same manuscript as sketches for "Skovsang" (NWGW 238), "Spansk Sang" (NWGW 311) and "Violerne" (NWGW 310).

titlePage.p: Sex / Danske Sange / med Piano, tilegnede / C.E.F. Weyse / af / Niels W. Gade / 2den Udgave / (1841. 1872.) Mærk! / I denne Udgave byttes de 2 Sange: / "Liden Kirsten" og "Barcarole" (Lette Bølge) / Plads, saaledes at begge Barcarolerne / følge efter hinanden. / Altsaa: / Liden Kirsten / Harlekin / Violerne. / Barcarole (Lette Bølge) / Barcarole (Natten er saa stille) / Spillemanden. / N W Gade.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in marbled cardboard cover with leather spine. With a handwritten label in the middle of the cover, inscribed: "Niels W. Gade / Sex Danske sange". Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. With corrections and remarks in blue and red crayon for the second edition.
